svg.title: Token Yield Marketplace: proposed Foundry architecture
svg.desc: Clients request work from marketplace agents hosted in Microsoft Foundry. The marketplace agents govern brick agents and consult a predictive model. Execution and prediction results flow to Microsoft Fabric, then to Power BI, Excel, Word, Teams and email. Feedback returns to the marketplace agents for governed improvement. This is a conceptual target, not a deployed integration. Connector authorization and human approval remain required.
svg.metadata: Official Microsoft product icons are embedded unmodified, with their original proportions and colors. Foundry: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/architecture/icons/ Archive: https://arch-center.azureedge.net/icons/Azure_Public_Service_Icons_V24.zip Fabric and Power BI: https://learn.microsoft.com/fabric/fundamentals/icons Archive: https://github.com/microsoft/fabric-samples/blob/main/docs-samples/Icons.zip Excel, Word, Teams and Outlook: https://res.cdn.office.net/files/fabric-cdn-prod_20230815.002/assets/brand-icons/product/svg/ Microsoft retains all rights in its product icons. Used to illustrate product relationships in an architecture diagram.
